explanation_short: KNN is the best performing model, showing superior metrics compared to other models, though the performance is limited by the scope of the tested features.
explanation_full: Observationally, the KNN model demonstrates the strongest performance across key metrics, achieving an R² of 0.81717 and an RMSE of 0.11318. This performance is notably better than the DT model (R²=0.56045) and the SVM model (R²=0.73241). Furthermore, the RF model (R²=0.77560) shows a strong performance, slightly edging out XGBoost (R²=0.74948). However, it should be noted that these results are based solely on the current feature set and may not generalize to different data distributions.
